method.package: Local npm pack from exact Publisher source commit; archive digest checked.
method.installation: Temporary HOME and cache; local archive installed with npm --offline, invalid registry, and scripts disabled.
method.execution: Installed public CLI with empty PATH and exact request digest; source-adjacent and installed Candidate members compared byte-for-byte.
method.relocation: Copied installed consumer and selected source tree, moved both original roots aside, rebuilt through the relocated public CLI, and compared every Candidate member byte-for-byte.
method.directComparison: Build both Editions with the same source commit and selected AIGW bytes; compare every member digest.
method.browser: Headless Chrome served the exact installed-equivalent HTML over loopback; every page was selected and checked for errors, external requests, node-body overlap, horizontal overflow, and axe WCAG A/AA violations.

limits: unreleased provisional package; not the selected AIGW release
macOS installed and relocated use and desktop Chrome machine checks only
source model claims are attributed, not independently verified
sourceRevision is the observed Git checkout, not a Provider content revision
Candidate input closure is selected-inputs-only, not complete dependency observation
no human visual acceptance of these exact Candidate bytes
no source-delta update or publication recovery proof
no AIGW acceptance, protected ref, hosted publication, or off-host disaster recovery
